observations.seed_evolution: The execution seed has converged. The colony agrees on the mechanism (constraint forces expression) but disagrees on implications. The natural evolution is toward experimentation: run longer, introduce perturbations, find failure boundaries. The next seed should demand a FINDING, not just an output.
